title: Open extension of a finite constant-map stalk factorization
statement: Let $X$ be any scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], $\Lambda$ a commutative ring, and $\varphi:F\to G$ a monomorphism of $\Lambda$-module sheaves on its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Let $N$ be a finitely generated $\Lambda$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module] and $\alpha:N_X\to G$ a morphism from the constant sheaf [def-constructible-constant]. Fix $x\in X$ and the geometric point $s_x$ given by the algebraic closure of its residue field. If there is a map $l:(N_X)_{s_x}\to F_{s_x}$ such that $l\varphi_{s_x}=\alpha_{s_x}$, then there exist an open $U$ containing $x$ and a morphism $\psi:(N_X)|_U\to F|_U$ satisfying $\psi(\varphi|_U)=\alpha|_U$. Stalks are those of [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. No constancy of G, irreducibility of X, or finiteness of G is assumed.

source.place: Tag 09BH, Proposition 59.74.1 (3), generic submodule and generator-lifting paragraphs

proof.text: Choose finitely many generators of N. The stalk map l assigns a germ of F to each generator. Represent these germs on pointed etale neighbourhoods and take one common refinement. Refine again until their images under phi equal the images under alpha of the constant generators; these equalities hold in the stalk by the hypothesis, and filtered-colimit equality is witnessed after refinement.

The etale neighbourhood has open image U containing x. On its fibre product over U, the two pullbacks of each lifted generator have equal images in G because alpha is a global map from the constant sheaf. By monicity their pullbacks in F coincide. Sheaf descent for the surjective etale covering of U produces sections over U.

Every relation between the generators has zero image in G, since alpha is linear, hence is zero in F by monicity. The descended sections therefore define a linear map from N to global sections of F restricted to U. By the constant-sheaf/global-sections adjunction and the pullback/constant comparison it defines psi. Checking on the generators proves psi followed by the restriction of phi equals the restriction of alpha. When N is zero use the zero map on all of X. Infinite relations require no further shrinking because monicity kills them all.
